A-Train Hotel Amsterdam | Official Website
Welcome to the Amazing A-Train Hotel Amsterdam
The A-Train Hotel is a unique 3 star hotel with a  train-theme . Our monumental building is ideally located in front of the Central (Railway) Station, right in the beating heart of Amsterdam. Shopping areas, tourist attractions, pubs, restaurants, theaters, are all within walking distance.
All  34 rooms  are comfortably furnished and have modern bathrooms with a hair-drier and are equipped with radio, satelite TV, safe, work desk, direct-dial telephone, free WIFI, airconditioning and wake-up system. The hotel has a elevator, a luggage store room and 24 hours check-in.
When booking on our website you always have  free breakfast  with you reservation!
The A-Train Hotel is a  cozy hotel , run by Jos Heijnsdijk, Erika Jonker and GM Ali Hassan and will be a comfortable place to stay during your tourist or business visit and will make you feel like "Home away from Home".

Rooms | A-Train Hotel Amsterdam
Our Rooms
All 34 rooms are comfortably furnished and have modern bathrooms with a hair-drier and are equipped with radio, satelite TV, laptopsize safe, work desk, direct-dial telephone, free WIFI, airconditioning and wake-up system.
Single Room
Small but comfortable non-smoking room with all above mentioned facilities.
Book this room
Twin/Double Room
Cosy comfortable room with one double bed or two single beds and all the above mentioned facilities.
Book this room
First Class Room
A spacious and luxurious decorated room with a great view of the Central Station, with one double bed or two single beds. Furthermore an easy chair, fridge, coffee and tea making and all above mentioned facilities.
Book this room
Old Dutch Suite
A uniquely old fashioned furnished room with a double bed and a small private garden/patio.
Furthermore a small fridge, coffee and tea making facilities and two easy chairs and of course all above mentioned facilities. The room is non-smoking, in the garden it is allowed to smoke.
Book this room
Triple Room
A comfortable room with three single beds and all above mentioned facilities.
Please note, this room is on 2 floors with stairs to the "sleeping area".
Book this room
Family double room
A comfortable small family room with one double and 1 children's bed (for a child under 11) and all basic facilities.
Furthermore a fridge, and a microwave.
Deluxe Family Room
A comfortable family room with one double and 1 single bed and 1 sofa bed (for a child under 11) and all basic facilities.
Furthermore a kitchenette, with a fridge and a microwave.
Book this room
Family Room
A comfortable family room with one double and 2 single beds on two floors and all above mentioned facilities.
Furthermore a kitchenette, with a fridge and microwave, coffee and tea making facilities and also a children's play corner with nice toys.
Book this room
Apartment
A spacious (56m2) apartment on two floors, this is also a family room, with one double and 3 single beds) and one bed for a child(1.50m long), cot available on request. Of course also with all the above mentioned facilities. Furthermore a kitchenette (no cooking), with a fridge and microwave, coffee and tea making facilities and also a children's play corner with nice toys. Please note, to get to this room, there is one flight of stairs to climb, between the 2nd and 3rd floor.
Book this room
